g.text: PPG foundation models versus the small CNN
Full label budgets; participant-paired difference = foundation-model MAE − CNN MAE
Negative differences favour the foundation model. Bars: 95% participant bootstrap intervals (10,000 resamples).
Seeds are averaged within participants before resampling. Exploratory intervals; no multiplicity adjustment.
